'''C9-RX0''', or simply '''C9''', was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that resided in the [[Taloraan City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] C9-RX0 assisted in the negotiations between [[Sech Govlinder]], emissary to city's magister [[Orlin Denache]], and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during their [[mission to Taloraan]]. After the first set of negotiations C9 accompanied Skywalker's padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], during her walk through the city and answered her questions about the planet's native fauna. After Ahsoka became interested in a warehouse guarded by armed men, she decided to investigate it. Once she left C9 to get a better look on the warehouse, the droid decided to simply ask the guards about its contents. He approached a man named [[Rynert]] and asked him the question directly. Little did the droid know that Rynert was in league with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the warehouse contained multiple stocked [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. Rynert destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], but not before he learned from him the whereabouts of Ahsoka Tano, whom he and the other guards proceeded to attack.
